svg.title: Local classification: one sensing layer
svg.text: Restore RTC schedule, daily state and queue
Wake from RTC or pending retry
Check current time and unsent state
Do not classify an invalid capture as healthy
10 s windows, 5 s stride + final tail
Energy variation is not an RPW decision
Run the local INT8 residual CNN
Quantize inputs with export scale / zero
Apply sigmoid to the window logit
RPW or healthy from the maximum score
Retain max score and quality statistics
Max score, battery and quality / fault flags
At least one report each day
ID / day, counts, scores, battery / status
Report even when no measurement is valid
Queue the packet before radio TX
Use sequence and schema / model version
Use the configured channel / SF / BW
Apply the planned TX slot / backoff
Gateway relays; queued data survives failure
Queue pending: schedule immediate TX wake
Else sleep until next sample / retry
EXTERNAL ENDPOINT ONLY - gateway relay and result storage
Gateway: validate / buffer the LoRa packet and forward over Wi-Fi or cellular.
Server: deduplicate by node / day / sequence, store daily results and update dashboard / RPW alerts.
No server acoustic classifier is required for this route; the node already made the recording-level decisions.
ONE piezo sensor + ONE ESP32-WROOM32 + ONE RFM95W link. Temporal windows are not extra sensing layers.
The 24-byte daily summary is a proposed body, not a measured complete radio frame. Reporting schedule and ACK/retry protocol require firmware implementation.
Local model is an INT8 deployment candidate. Feature parity, contiguous RAM, inference timing and energy must be measured on the actual ESP32.
Daily reporting remains required even after rejected captures. The energy-variation proxy is a quality statistic, not proof of RPW activity.
